claims.claim: Grounded QA exposes exactly one new public async API, answer_grounded_context, without additional authority types.
The composition calls build, invoke, and create exactly once each in the required execution order.
Successful composition returns the exact GroundedAnswer while preserving context identity and payload values.
Predecessor failures and cancellation propagate unchanged, short-circuiting later stages without retry or fallback.
Structurally invalid model payloads remain subject to TASK-129 validation and are not repaired or reclassified.
The composition introduces no direct provider transport, retrieval, parsing, prompt reconstruction, storage, or tool behavior.
Existing predecessor and product-truth authority boundaries remain unchanged.
The focused repair removes the unintended public annotations name and makes the static test check exact allowed-call membership and count without inferring execution order from ast.walk.
